LESSON: CONCEPTS OF YOG

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.1: Concepts of Yog

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Concepts of Yog. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How is Yog beneficial in developing life skills?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain what Concepts of Yog means in simple pupil language
2. give 3 correct examples of Concepts of Yog from Kenya
3. practise Concepts of Yog in clear steps
4. apply Concepts of Yog in one real-life situation this week

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: CONCEPTS OF YOG
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 7
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Concepts of Yog helps you succeed in HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: CONCEPTS OF YOG
Study Concepts of Yog like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Explain what Concepts of Yog means in simple pupil language

What this means
In this part you learn to explain what Concepts of Yog means in simple pupil language. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain what Concepts of Yog means in simple pupil language.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Concepts of Yog” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain what Concepts of Yog means in simple pupil language. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Give 3 correct examples of Concepts of Yog from Kenya

What this means
In this part you learn to give 3 correct examples of Concepts of Yog from Kenya. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: give 3 correct examples of Concepts of Yog from Kenya.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Concepts of Yog in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can give 3 correct examples of Concepts of Yog from Kenya. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Practise Concepts of Yog in clear steps

What this means
In this part you learn to practise Concepts of Yog in clear steps. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: practise Concepts of Yog in clear steps.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can practise Concepts of Yog in clear steps. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Apply Concepts of Yog in one real-life situation this week

What this means
In this part you learn to apply Concepts of Yog in one real-life situation this week. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: apply Concepts of Yog in one real-life situation this week.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Concepts of Yog” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can apply Concepts of Yog in one real-life situation this week. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Concepts of Yog is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Concepts of Yog” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: explain what Concepts of Yog means in simple pupil language)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Concepts of Yog in your own words. (skill: give 3 correct examples of Concepts of Yog from Kenya)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: practise Concepts of Yog in clear steps)

Example 4: Show how “Concepts of Yog” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: apply Concepts of Yog in one real-life situation this week)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Concepts of Yog to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain what Concepts of Yog means in simple pupil language.
3. Practise this skill: give 3 correct examples of Concepts of Yog from Kenya.
4. Practise this skill: practise Concepts of Yog in clear steps.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Concepts of Yog from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Concepts of Yog: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 7 learner study Concepts of Yog?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How is Yog beneficial in developing life skills?
2. Why is Yog significant in spiritual nourishment?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Concepts of Yog means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain what Concepts of Yog means in simple pupil language.
5. Be able to: give 3 correct examples of Concepts of Yog from Kenya.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
